evidence.detail: Six MFA push prompts were sent to finance-admin in 94 seconds. The final prompt was accepted.
Belgrade login occurred 11 minutes after a Chicago session for the same account.
New desktop client grant requested mail.read, files.read, and offline_access scopes.
Refresh token family reused from AS58224 with no enrolled device record.
A 1.8 GB payroll archive was downloaded through the suspicious OAuth grant.
PowerShell child process touched browser credential cache metadata on finance-endpoint-12.
